sloka: तमास्थाय महातेजा रथं हरिरथोपमम्।जगाम सहसा तत्र यत्र युद्धमरिन्दमः ।। ६.७३.९ ।।
transliteration: tamāsthāya mahātejā rathaṁ harirathopamam।jagāma sahasā tatra yatra yuddhamarindamaḥ ।। 6.73.9 ।।

translations.english: Highly energetic he (Indrajith) was, a tamer of enemies, seated in the chariot that was like Indra's, quickly went to the battlefield from there.
